acceptanceCriteria: With carryOver set, argv elements other than the prompt element may hold the ordinary placeholders ({role}, {ticketLocal}, {worker}, ...); only the prompt element must be a whole {prompt}; any placeholder that stays unsafe is named in the refusal and the spec (tests)
dispatch status (or a new dispatch validate) exits non-zero when the on-disk config is INVALID, naming the reason (test)

Startup with an invalid file and a previously applied config either runs on the last applied config with a loud warning, or the behavior that a restart drops to no dispatcher is documented; the choice is recorded in the ATR spec with a requirement ID (test or doc)
ATR spec amended; focused dispatch tests pass
body: GitHub #1157. Setting carryOver on a role makes the dispatch config INVALID when the host argv has any element with a placeholder other than a whole {prompt} (e.g. --title "<prefix> {role} {ticketLocal} {worker}"): 'role <r> sets carryOver but host "<h>" argv element 9 holds a placeholder other than a whole {prompt}'. A running dispatcher refuses the reload (config.refused) and keeps the old config while dispatch status exits 0; the next restart exits rc 1 outcome ERROR every time, so a supervisor loop idles all work.
title: GH #1157: dispatch carryOver rejects host argv elements with non-prompt placeholders, and a refused config only surfaces at restart
